title: Integration record of a factory run (integration.json)
description: What `factory integrate` did with the accepted lanes of one run: each is cherry-picked, in queue order, onto an integration branch that starts at the run's base, then judged by a2dlc check and by the sealed holdout on that branch. Only a lane that passes both is committed there. The main branch is never written: main_sha_before and main_sha_after are equal or the command fails.

head_sha.description: The integration branch after the last lane; the base when nothing was integrated.

queue_position.description: Order in which the lane was tried; null for a lane that never queued.

rebased.description: The integration branch had moved past the lane's base when the lane was applied.

conflicts.description: Files that did not apply; only for status conflict.

commit.description: The lane's commit on the integration branch; only for status integrated.

holdout_files.description: Holdout files that ran for this lane: its own and those of the lanes integrated before it.

holdout_exit.description: The holdout command's exit code. Its output goes to holdout-logs/<issue>.log beside the record, never into it: it carries the holdout's text and canary by design, and no builder or retry prompt may read it.
